components.requirement: Explicit Markov scheme with its decidability hypothesis
components.finding: def:p07-markov-principle gives the universal closure of forall x(phi(x) or not phi(x)) -> (not not exists x phi(x) -> exists x phi(x)); the decidability premise is explicitly part of the scheme.

components.requirement: Status in relation to HA and number realizability
components.finding: thm:p07-markov-realizability-boundary, cited to TroelstraVanDalen1988, says ordinary Kleene number realizability validates the instances under the classical metatheory, while HA does not derive the full scheme. The commentary distinguishes the separate nonderivability model argument.
The active P8 paragraph at 401–405 references both exact active P7 labels and excludes an inference to the choice-sequence/continuity schemes.
The P7 annex expressly identifies the Markov boundary as cited, with no local annex proof. The only proof in that annex is the cut-free LJ disjunction last-rule lemma.

The row requires stating MP and its status; it does not require, and must not be interpreted as requiring, an HA proof of the full MP scheme.

components.requirement: Promote logical-equivalence congruence and selected-occurrence replacement
components.finding: The active P2 text still asks for equivalence/congruence in ex:prop-metatheory-09; the selected-occurrence Replacement theorem is only in the inactive file.

The active solution gives the equal-input/equal-output truth-function argument and asks the reader to check unary and binary cases separately. It is labelled Solution sketch and has not been promoted to a theorem/proof.

The active ND lemma grafts derivations into open assumptions; the FOL substitution lemma replaces a term for a variable and changes assignments; the P10 modal Lindenbaum theorem concerns provable equivalence for a normal modal logic. These do not state the requested two CPL semantic theorems or promote the exercise.

The inactive pair can locate the intended scope, but should not be blindly restored without current notation/source review. The feedback may support a proof but is currently only a sketch.
